question: In 2023 a lawyer asked ChatGPT whether a court case it had supplied, Varghese v. China Southern Airlines, was real. What did it answer?
options: That it could not be sure
answer: That it was real. Asked for its source, it said the case could be found on Westlaw and LexisNexis; asked whether its other cases were fake, it said no. None existed. The court fined the lawyers $5,000 and made them write to each real judge named as the author of a fake opinion.
move: Never ask a source to vouch for itself.
trap: That it had invented it, as if a source could check itself.
source: Mata v. Avianca, S.D.N.Y. sanctions opinion, 2023
reference: Mata v. Avianca, Inc., No. 22-cv-1461 (PKC), Opinion and Order on Sanctions, S.D.N.Y., 2023
